title: Denmark’s TV2 Seeks Penance With Acting Program Director Hire After ‘Everyone Loves Rasmus’ Debacle
summary: Denmark's TV 2 appoints an interim programming chief after controversy, signaling shifts in commissioning and casting opportunities.
content: Denmark’s TV2 has dipped into the independent production market for an Acting Program Director as it seeks penance over the scandal around Truman Show -like reality series Everybody Loves Rasmus Sune Roland will take up the position on December 1, and will lead the TV2 programming division during a period the network “is working to rebuild the Danish public’s trust.” Given his position is an acting role, it’s not certain he will be TV2’s long-term program chief just yet. This follows the departures of Content Director Ulla Pors and Program Director Dorthe Thirstrup following the disastrous launch of Alle Elsker Rasmus ( Everybody Loves Rasmus ). Related Stories News Content Chiefs At Denmark's TV2 Step Down To "Restore Trust" After Backlash Over 'Truman Show'-Style Reality Series News Banijay Takes On Norway's 'The Comedy League' The show faced immense public backlash for duping comedian Rasmus Wallbridge into believing his dream film concept was being produced. It was scrapped soon after launch, and TV2’s directors have launched an investigation into how the show was greenlit in the first place. Their response has been fast and decisive during in an almost unprecedented situation for a major European broadcaster. Watch on Deadline Roland is a former TV2 exec, having risen as high as Head of Content, and returns after four years in the independent production sector. He had worked as Managing Director of Strong Productions, the Fremantle Denmark production house that merged with Blu last year. Following his exit there, he launched his own company, Shift Studios. Frederik Lauesen, who was installed as Acting Content Director at TV2 in the aftermath of the scandal, said: “I am very pleased that Sune Roland has agreed to take on the role of Acting Programme Director. Sune brings extensive experience; he is well-liked and respected within the industry and possesses a deep understanding of both TV 2 and the Danish production landscape. title: ‘All of a Sudden’: Why Does an 11-Minute Scene Centered on a Whiteboard Lecture Work So Well Onscreen?
summary: The film's 11-minute whiteboard lecture succeeds through high stakes, escalating reveals, and precise performance rhythm—useful acting craft.
content: It is an unorthodox sequence. In the middle of “ All of a Sudden, ” Mari ( Tao Okamoto ) pulls out a whiteboard and markers to diagram the principles of nature vs. capitalism for her new friend Marie-Lou ( Virginie Efira ). The scene lasts 11 minutes and digs into material you would expect in a university seminar, not the latest cinematic achievement from the Oscar-winning director of “ Drive My Car ,” Ryūsuke Hamaguchi. While a guest on this week’s Filmmaker Toolkit Podcast , Hamaguchi acknowledged the whiteboard is not what we generally consider to be cinematic, but then again neither is the three-hour-and-17-minute film about two women who form a powerful bond by talking about life, their life’s work, and the ever so sexy topic of eldercare for dementia patients. Related Stories How Much of Quentin Tarantino’s Scrapped Film ‘The Movie Critic’ Made It Into ‘The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth’? Robert Aramayo’s Star-Making Turn in ‘I Swear’ Is Already Award-Winning, Now He Just Wants People to See It And yet “ All of a Sudden ” blew away the world’s toughest critics at Cannes. Now, its distributor, Neon, heads into this weekend’s holiday theatrical release believing it has a legit shot at winning over the more commercially oriented Oscar voters — and becoming one of the (increasingly common) foreign-language Best Picture nominations . Neon similarly released “Sentimental Value” and “The Secret Agent” to Best Picture nominations the year before. The whiteboard scene is not an extraneous aside, but a critical turning point in the women’s relationship. We asked the film’s writer/director why it not only works, but was deemed vital to the film. “In trying to answer why this somehow works, I think there’s a few layers to it,” said Hamaguchi while on IndieWire’s Filmmaker Toolkit podcast. “And one maybe is because it really is something that is far removed from what is generally considered as cinematic. title: Mario Van Peebles, Abderrahmane Sissako Set for Ivory Coast’s SICA as African Content Economy Takes Center Stage
summary: SICA in Ivory Coast spotlights Africa's content boom, with Van Peebles and Sissako, offering networking and co-production opportunities.
content: Financing, distribution and Africa’s creative economy are set to focus discussions at 2026's SICA market in Abidjan American actor-director Mario Van Peebles (“New Jack City”), Oscar-nominated Mauritanian filmmaker Abderrahmane Sissako (“Timbuktu”), Nigerian filmmaker Kunle Afolayan (“Aníkúlápó”) and French actor-director Jean-Pascal Zadi (“Simply Black”) are among the industry figures set to attend the fourth edition of Ivory Coast’s International Salon for Audiovisual Content of Abidjan ( SICA ). Taking place Nov. 26-28 at the Sofitel Hôtel Ivoire, the market expects to welcome more than 5,000 visitors and professionals from 40 countries, with a focus on the economics of content creation and cultural diplomacy. Related Stories Marvel’s ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Won’t Screen for BAFTA, Golden Globes and Other Early Awards Groups to Guard Its Spoilers (EXCLUSIVE) Sequels, Subtitles and Spring Releases: How the Best Picture Race Is Rewriting the Academy’s Playbook The gathering comes amid considerable upheaval in Africa’s media landscape. Pay-TV subscriptions in sub-Saharan Africa fell 2.8% to 33.2 million in 2025, according to research firm Omdia. Following its acquisition of South African pay-TV operator MultiChoice in September 2025, French media group Canal+ shut down MultiChoice’s streaming platform Showmax in April, citing financial losses. At SICA, a panel on adapting to streaming platforms and new distribution models will bring together representatives of Ivorian networks RTI, NCI, A+ Ivoire, Life TV and 7info alongside Netflix and broadcasters from Senegal, Cameroon, Benin and Canada. A separate discussion will examine how regulation can strengthen the market for local content on national television channels. The theatrical sector, meanwhile, offers encouraging signs. title: Peter Berg on the ‘Two Truths’ of War in ‘The Mosquito Bowl’ and the ‘Incredibly Funny’ ‘Hancock 2’ Script Will Smith Sent Him: ‘I Love Will Smith, and I Always Will’
summary: Peter Berg discusses war themes in The Mosquito Bowl and a promising Hancock 2 script, hinting future casting prospects.
content: The filmmaker also teases Captain Price probably coming to “Call of Duty” and lays out what a “Friday Night Lights” reboot needs before anyone writes a script. The 62-year-old filmmaker behind epics like “Lone Survivor” and “Deepwater Horizon” and the sports drama series “Friday Night Lights” may have made his most personal film yet with the World War II drama “ The Mosquito Bowl .” He also, it turns out, has a knack for timing. When we spoke on Nov. 13, a global Microsoft outage had knocked Outlook offline for millions of users the day before. Berg held it up as a warning shot, proof of how little it would take for the world to go dark in a war with China. Your bank accounts won’t work. Every system that we are depending on will shut down instantly,” he says. “What we saw was just a tiny taste of what that can feel like.” That same afternoon, the Federal Aviation Administration ordered a nationwide ground stop after a communications failure hit the country’s air traffic control centers, halting every departing flight in the United States. Then I received a text message from Berg. Based on Buzz Bissinger’s 2022 book “The Mosquito Bowl: A Game of Life and Death in World War II,” the film follows a group of college football stars who joined the Marine Corps after Pearl Harbor, played a now-legendary game on Guadalcanal on Christmas Eve 1944 and landed on Okinawa months later. Many of them never came home. Nicholas Galitzine, Bill Skarsgård, Ray Nicholson and Tom Francis lead the ensemble and Berg steps in front of the camera as Lt. Gen. Simon Buckner. title:
'The Trip' Returns for Fifth Installment, Next Sending Steve Coogan and
 Rob Brydon to Frigid Arctic Circle
summary: The Trip returns for season five in the Arctic Circle, sustaining demand for improv-driven comedy and travel production talent.
content: What does “Michael Caine” sound like in the freezing cold? We’re about to find out with the just-announced release of “ The Trip to the Northern Lights,” which is the reunion of Steve Coogan , Rob Brydon , and director Michael Winterbottom for what is the fifth installment of “The Trip” franchise of miniseries/movies. Independent Film Company and Sapan Studio picked up the U.S. rights to the fifth “Trip” film (IFC has released all four of the other films into theaters in the U.S.) and will release it theatrically on April 9, 2027. It will have been nearly seven years since the release of the last feature, and it sees Brydon now at 60 and Coogan at 59, so we’re guessing their ages may have made their wit and appetites even more ornery since. Related Stories Danielle Brooks Shares Insights from the Indie Success of ‘If I Go Will They Miss Me’ What Are Local Movie Theaters Showing for Thanksgiving 2026? “The Trip” movies are known for their food and travel porn as much as they are for their litany of impressions between Coogan and Brydon playing versions of themselves, but this one turns that concept on its head slightly by sending Coogan and Brydon up north, this time throughout Scandinavia, including Sweden and some islands in Norway, all in search of some other fine food and wry conversation. The first look at the movie above sees the duo in ridiculously huge parkas in the snow as guided by some sled huskies. Try doing your best Bane impression at 10 below zero. “We are very happy to be back on the road with IFC. They have been brilliant partners ever since the first ‘Trip’ all those years ago. ‘ The Trip to the Northern Lights ‘ takes Steve and Rob from Malmo in southern Sweden through Norway’s spectacular fjords to the Lofoten Islands in Norway’s Arctic circle,” Winterbottom said. “I hope the audience enjoys the journey as much as we did.” “The Trip” franchise began all the way back in 2011, and since then the films have spanned trips in England, Italy, Spain, and

title:
How Much of Quentin Tarantino's Scrapped Film 'The Movie Critic' Made
 It Into 'The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth'?
summary: Tarantino folded ideas from his scrapped The Movie Critic into a Cliff Booth book, leaving no imminent screen roles.
content: [Editor’s note: The following story contains minor spoilers for “ The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth .”] A few years ago, Quentin Tarantino was set to direct one last movie to fulfill his self-imposed ten film limit before riding off into the sunset. And while he was open about his desire to stay creative in other mediums, not even the most outside-the-box thinkers would have predicted that his next big screen project would be a Netflix movie he wrote for David Fincher . “The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth” is an unlikely miracle that emerged for a few distinct reasons: Tarantino’s hesitance to commit to his final directing effort, Brad Pitt ‘s determination to play Cliff Booth again and his longtime friendship with David Fincher, and of course, the collapse of Tarantino’s planned film “ The Movie Critic .” Related Stories Robert Aramayo’s Star-Making Turn in ‘I Swear’ Is Already Award-Winning, Now He Just Wants People to See It Danielle Brooks Shares Insights from the Indie Success of ‘If I Go Will They Miss Me’ Given that “The Movie Critic” was also reportedly set in 1970s Los Angeles, and Pitt had signed on to reprise his “Once Upon a Time in Hollywood” role, there was always going to be speculation about that script turning into “The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth.” Tarantino pours gasoline on that flame in the new film when Karen Crosby (Elizabeth Debicki), the Hollywood manager who serves as both a foil and love interest to Booth, reveals that she used to be a film critic before moving into talent representation. The revelation is not crucial to the plot, though it does provide some clever character development as she explains her view that all movies are the culinary equivalent of hamburgers: enjoyable, but not worthy of serious analysis. title: The Show Must Go On: Broadway Will Perform Saturday In Macy’s Thanksgiving Parade
summary: Saturday parade performances give Broadway casts national TV exposure and potential ticket boosts.
content: New Yorkers woke up this Thanksgiving morning to drizzly, gray skies along with winds that had sidewalks covered in dead, yellow leaves, though the weather throughout the pre-noon hours was hardly the fearsome nor’easter blast that prompted the postponement till Saturday of Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade. Still, with wind levels of up to 23 mph – and gusts considerably stronger – the postponement appears to have been justified, and the worst of the storm is yet to come. The impact of the postponement on performances that had been scheduled for today – marching bands, celebrity appearances, the big Broadway medley involving nine different shows – was still be dealt with as of this morning. Will Coss, Macy’s executive producer of the parade, told the Today show this morning that organizers are “actively working through all the pieces of our parade, but I have to say there’s an overwhelming positive response.” Related Stories News Mayor Zohran Mamdani Says Famed Balloons Will Soar Again At Rescheduled Macy's Parade: "It's The Only Inflation We Support In New York City" News Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade Postponed To Saturday Due To Severe Weather; NBC Will Rerun 2025 Parade On Thursday Coss continued, “Our performers, our talent, our performance groups, our bands, we’re all coming together to try to figure this out, and we’re optimistic that we’re going to have a really successful parade on Saturday morning.” Watch on Deadline While Coss didn’t specify which performances are on schedule, Deadline can confirm that the Broadway medley that was planned in lieu of the traditional individual show performances is a go for Saturday. What Macy’s is calling the “ All-Star Broadway Thanksgiving Day Celebration ” will go on as planned, with performers from The Lost Boys, The Rocky Horror Show, Wicked, Schmigadoon!, Aladdin, The Book of Mormon and Chicago confirmed. title: ‘Top Gear’ Sets 2028 Return — With Gordon Ramsay as Host
summary: Top Gear will relaunch in 2028 with Gordon Ramsay, creating future presenting, guest, and production opportunities.
content: Top Gear is set to return to the BBC with entrepreneur, chef and self-proclaimed car fanatic Gordon Ramsay as its host. The U.K.’s beloved, long-running series has been off air since 2022 after co-host Andrew Flintoff was involved in an on-set car crash. He suffered serious facial and rib injuries when his open-top vehicle overturned on Top Gear ‘s test track. On Wednesday, the broadcaster confirmed that the world’s most celebrated motoring entertainment show (previously helmed by Jeremy Clarkson, James May and Richard Hammond) will be back on our screens in 2028. Related Stories Movies Director Cédric Klapisch to Receive César Lifetime Achievement Honor Guest Column Bowen Yang, Mark Ruffalo and the Rise of Antisemitism in Hollywood (Guest Column) Produced by BBC Studios , the all-new series will see Ramsay take the steering wheel, “setting the agenda and leading an all-new lineup of co-presenters through epic adventures, daring tests and spectacular stunts in pursuit of the stories, machines and mayhem that generations of viewers have come to expect and love from the show.” Filming will take place across the U.K. and around the world in 2027, with the iconic Top Gear Test Track at Dunsfold Aerodrome in Surrey once again serving as the show’s home and base. Top Gear ’s tame racing driver, The Stig, will also be returning to support the new series in the usual understated way. Ramsay is no stranger to the show, having been a guest previously on three occasions: in the show’s first series in 2002, its eighth series in 2006 and its 23rd series in 2017. Each appearance saw him showcase his driving skills with a lap of the track — his fastest time clocking in at a blistering one minute and 46.3 seconds behind the wheel of a Chevrolet Lacetti — earning him 7th place on Top Gear’s ‘Star In A Reasonably Priced Car’ leaderboard. “My love affair with cars began as a child, growing up a field away from Silverstone, where I would climb over the fences and sneak in for a glimpse

title: taking over the role
summary: Guidance for stepping into an existing character: respect continuity, add nuance, and manage quick rehearsal demands.
content: The Disney+ series has cast Courtney B. Vance to take up the mantle from the late Lance Reddick, who died last year , shortly after the first season was released. “Finding someone to step into this role going forward was not an easy task, but when icon Courtney B. Vance answered the call, we knew the Gods were listening,” executive producer Dan Shotz said in a statement, posted to the series’ Instagram on Monday. “This legend of cinema not only wanted to honor the books, but wanted to honor Lance’s legacy. We can’t wait for you all to see him take the throne.” Related Stories News UK Actors Union Equity To Kickstart Negotiations With Streamers Early Next Year News Black Friday Streaming Deals Offered By Disney+, HBO Max, Paramount+, Peacock & More In the Season 1 finale of the Disney+ series, Reddick played the Greek god in an extensive scene with series lead Walker Scobell, as Percy faces Zeus atop Mount Olympus. It was one of his final on-screen roles . Watch on Deadline Zeus has a presence throughout all five of Rick Riordan’s Percy Jackson and the Olympians novels. Earlier this year, Shotz and fellow EP Jon Steinberg spoke about recasting the role , saying at the time: “There’s also just a little bit of denial, I think. That’s something that we’re gonna have to deal with. But we’re incredibly grateful for this character that he helped build and the presence that he created. I do not envy whoever has to step into his shoes.” Season 2 of Percy Jackson will follow Percy Jackson (Scobell), Annabeth Chase (Jeffries) and Grover Underwood (Simhadri) as they embark on a new adventure based on The Sea of Monsters, the second book of Rick Riordan’s best-selling “Percy Jackson and the Olympians” series, published by Disney Hyperion. Production on Season 2 just began in Vancouver in August. In the new season, Percy Jackson returns to Camp Half-Blood one year later to find his world turned upside down.
